description: Send a message. Needs `inbox:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

body.description: The text, up to 10,000 characters. A body, attachments, or both. It is screened before it is sent.

client_key.description: A retry key (1 to 64 characters): sending again with it answers the first message.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

file_ids.description: Up to 10 ready uploads of mine (scope message_attachment).

name: send_message
title: Send a message
